literal: If living life even by begging is required, let the creator of the world wander and perish.
translation: If the creator of the world has decreed that people must survive only by begging, may that creator too wander aimlessly and perish.
modern: இரந்து இரந்துதான் உயிர் வாழ வேண்டும் என்ற நிலை இருக்குமானால், இந்த உலகத்தைப் படைத்தவனும் இரந்து அலைந்து அழிந்து போகட்டும்.
explanation: In this powerful couplet, the poet expresses deep anger against the existence of poverty and begging. He declares that if the creator of the world (இயற்றியான்) designed a system where some people must sustain their lives (உயிர்வாழ்தல்) only by begging (இரந்தும்), then that creator deserves to wander around (பரந்து) and perish (கெடுக). The word 'பரந்து' suggests wandering like a beggar, and 'கெடுக' is a strong curse, highlighting the absolute injustice of a world where begging is necessary for survival.
